Elena Krayeva is an exemplary Soviet citizen. Carefree and outgoing, she has long been a regular sight at Pavlov Complex cultural events. One of the leading dog trainers in the Soviet Union, or "Pavlov's Dog," as he jokingly calls himself, Gromyko is a crucial member of the Facility 3826 staff. His published works on raising, training, and cross-breeding species have been translated into 64 languages, five of them by himself. However, despite all his talents and service to the Motherland, this modest dog breeder prefers the company of his four-legged friends to scientific debates. Especially valuable in light of Polymer-based biotechnology is his work on breeding and training martian and lunar "dogs," i.e. the Polymer-based organisms known as Plyusch, which, thanks to Comrade Gromyko's hard work and care, are now exemplary, obedient representatives of man's future interplanetary best friend.

One of the highest-ranking leaders in the Communist Party, Molotov is also the President of the Council of Ministers and a political opponent of Comrade Sechenov. A talented politician used to operate on an international scale, he was made the overseer of Facility 3826 by the CPSU Central Committee and the Council of Ministers.
